acceptance_criteria: The compiler rejects an unknown Profile, an unknown Profile version, an unknown namespace, and an unknown field with a stable structured diagnostic.
The extension is additive and domain-neutral; no domain-specific or thesis-specific value is embedded.
No second configuration language and no generic unvalidated extension bag is introduced.
applicability: Phase 1 XDL Lite bounded software allocation (offline declared experiment intent compilation). status 'accepted' records internal engineering intent only; it is not implementation satisfaction or external delivery acceptance.
statement: The compiler shall consume one explicitly admitted, versioned, neutral experiment Profile at existing XDL extension points, with unknown namespaces, unknown fields, and unsupported versions failing closed.
title: Additive, explicitly admitted, fail-closed Profile extension
verification_intent: Planned to be exercised through the XDL1-UNIT, XDL1-STATIC, XDL1-INTEGRATION, and XDL1-VALIDATION measures defined in the XDL1 verification-design stage, invoking the real loader, schema registry, catalog, activation-plan consumer, and additive CLI/API. No runtime, availability, compatibility, or readiness claim is made.
